_comment: Editable by Dave. Seeded from real rates already in use elsewhere in this repo (see each field's source), not invented figures. Vendor dashboards are not assumed reachable — every Merlin cost figure is an estimate derived from countable activity against these rates.

anthropicHaiku.source: config/diagnoser-config.json and config/checker-config.json rates (both use Haiku)

fixedMonthlyUsd.twilioSubscriptionNote: No fixed monthly fee documented for Twilio in this project — usage-based only (SMS segments).
fixedMonthlyUsd.zohoEmailNote: Assumed pre-existing business email subscription, not itemized as pipeline spend.
